quick_context: aahp-runner v0.3.0 on main; two PRs open from this session. PR #29 (T-013, closes issue #27) adds optional token-usage fields to RunMetric (inputTokens/outputTokens/cacheReadTokens/cacheCreationTokens/modelId), wired into the SDK and Copilot backends; CLI backends leave them undefined. Both unblock aahp-hub T-005 and T-004 respectively. 209 tests pass on PR #30, 195 on PR #29 (was 190 on main). Awaiting review.
